build_login_local_endpoint: build a FastAPI login endpoint that authenticates users with email and password and sets an HttpOnly session cookie
create_register_endpoint: create a user registration endpoint that validates email and password strength before creating a new user account
refactor_change_password_endpoint: refactor the change password endpoint to also support updating the user email and clearing the setup flag
review_initialize_admin_endpoint: review the admin initialization endpoint that creates the first admin account on system boot
test_password_validation: test the strong password validator that rejects common passwords from a blocklist of known weak passwords
